column7: Bounds what an untrusted provider can put in the log and in the error a login ends with: only a listed RFC 6749 error code passes, any other text reads as other

Runs a login up to its redeemed code: callback server, PKCE, state-checked callback, the RFC 9207 issuer check (validate_issuer, its own critical row) and the exchange; a mistake would skip the issuer check or the confirm window
